description: Eleven free Claude skills that test a business before you launch it: a board trained on Hormozi, Thiel and Jobs, a marketing director, a CFO, and a consumer panel of 100 buyer agents. Free, MIT.

summary.one_liner: A set of eleven free Claude skills that test a business idea before launch, covering a simulated advisory board, competitor research, a 100-agent consumer panel, pricing, offers, unit economics, marketing, branding, operations, launch planning and a compiled business plan.
summary.what_it_does: The repo provides eleven Claude skills, each a folder with a SKILL.md, run in a fixed order and sharing files through a founder/ folder in the user's project. A board skill has three sub-agents apply published-framework lenses to score an idea, name its kill risks and vote fund, fund-if or pass. Competitor and consumer skills map public competitors and run a panel of 100 simulated buyer agents by default, tallying who buys and why. Pricing, offer, CFO, marketing, brand, ops and launch skills build on those outputs, and a planning skill compiles everything into a business plan with a computed verdict of Profitable, Not yet or Incomplete. Four standard-library Python tools handle unit economics, panel dealing and tallying, Van Westendorp price range calculation, and plan compilation; none touch the network. The README includes a worked example (a matcha cafe) with its numbers.
use_cases: test a business idea before spending money on launch
model unit economics and break-even for a product or cafe
find price range and objections using simulated buyers
compile a business plan with a computed profitability verdict
plan operations, suppliers and permits for a new business
run a cheap pop-up test before a full launch
how_to_run: Paste the repo link into Claude and say 'install skill', or install as a Claude Code plugin with /plugin marketplace add Jakeschincariol/founder-skill
Copy the folders instead: git clone the repo, then cp -r founder-skill/skills/founder-* ~/.claude/skills/
Run the skills in order: board, competitors, consumer, pricing, offer, cfo, marketing, brand, ops, launch, plan
stack: Claude / Claude Code skills and sub-agents
notable: Eleven skills that share outputs through a founder/ folder, run in a defined order
Consumer panel spins up 100 buyer agents from a target customer profile, each with its own income, habits and objection
Plan verdict is computed from the numbers (Profitable, Not yet or Incomplete), not written by the model
Python tools use only the standard library and do not touch the network
Van Westendorp tool finds acceptable price range from panel or real survey answers
caveats: Simulated buyers are not real customers; the README says language models lean agreeable, so the buy rate is an upper bound and big calls should be confirmed with real people
Board lenses are summaries of published frameworks, not the named authors, and the project is not affiliated with them
Financial figures are estimates that depend on inputs; the README says to check costs with suppliers and tax or payroll with an accountant; not financial, legal or tax advice
